name: codexy
description: Codex orchestrator scaffolding for atomic agent workflows, verification, evidence capture, and merge-safe execution.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex work through atomic orchestration, evidence, review, and merge gates.
interface.longDescription: Codex orchestrator for task-selected workflows, specialist roles, evidence capture, and safe review gates across repository, external, artifact, data, research, and local work.
defaultPrompt: You MUST use $orchestration first to classify the active Codex task and select its workflow surface.
You MUST apply selected surface gates and use applicable repository, GitHub, browser, artifact, data, research, or local proof.
For Korean replies, you MUST use plain, idiomatic Korean and MUST keep machine-readable evidence separate from the user summary.
